note: Real rounds whose unknown the user has judged by eye (docs/map-control-unknown-plan.md). scripts/control_cases.py recomputes each round with this checkout's engine from the friends site's public responses and checks the side group's unknown at the tick at or before t: 'unknown' means every listed cell must be in it, 'clear' means none may be. Cells are [x px, y px] on the 1024 px minimap. 'state' cases list `states` (control_format.STATE_NAMES); each listed cell's state must be one of them. Run it after any engine change, before a recompute.
